success.description: You force all dark essence to fall back. Effect: Every Dark, Necromantic, or Chaos magic spells within range are dispelled unless its caster succeeds in an Average (2{Dc}) Discipline (WP) test.
As above, and all the effects of this spell extend to long range. HUR Any caster of Dark, Chaos, or Necromantic magic within range suffers 2 stress.

sigmarsComet.description: Apply also the effects of the reckless side

success.description: You force all dark essence to fall back. Effect: Every Daemon or Undead within range is destroyed unless it succeeds in an Average (2{Dc}) Resilience (To) test.
As above, and all the effects of this spell extend to long range. HUR Any Daemon or Undead within range suffers 1 wound.
